model.name: T-file-unit: Files become scenario units (uuid.content + scenario.json + unitLinks[])
model.description: Files uploaded into a room are stored in the uuid index as <uuid>.content PLUS a <uuid>.scenario.json referencing the content, with unitLinks[] symlinks (e.g. in the room folder on the filesystem). Every file becomes a unique scenario unit. Singular-chain by design.
